scope: Bounded Redis observation for mirror-backlog-client-restart; real chaos observer and real Redis client against controlled peers. No full case-equivalence claim.

ci_failure.head: f48610979e9902d7b6da83fb444436b84876fb4d
ci_failure.observed: Before the backlog fault is armed, the inner-Docker MGET head:0 head:1 head:2 command times out after 20 seconds. The error aborts baseline capture.
ci_failure.unproven: Redis, Consul DNS and Docker execution latency are not individually attributed.

change.baseline: Replace pinned-primary Docker reads with fresh discovery and one atomic ROLE/MGET/HMGET snapshot. The existing 120-second row budget now bounds head and row observation together. Failed reads retry only inside that budget.
change.recovery: Retain the 300-second budget. Every writer must advance twice beyond the baseline while exact account state is observed on the same primary. Primary change starts a new pair of observations.
change.during_fault: Read the pinned fault primary directly and require exact held heads and stale account state. Fault writes, TTL, mirror stop/restore and cleanup retain their original Docker path.
change.errors: Persistent errors preserve the last cause; a hanging observation cannot extend the outer deadline.
change.service_impact: No product service wiring, state format, hot path or client timeout change. This modifies the chaos observer.

error_propagation_control.scope: The newly extracted observer initially retains the original immediate error propagation. Controls expose abort on transient baseline/recovery errors and failure before the recovery deadline. This is not a rerun of the original nested Docker command.

redis_compatibility.result: Disposable actual Redis accepts ROLE/MGET/HMGET inside MULTI/EXEC and returns exact role, all three heads and account row.
redis_compatibility.cleanup: Owned probe container removed in finally; 12 existing cluster containers remain.

clock_correction.initial_failure: The read expires at 3.001 virtual seconds, exceeding an exact three-second assertion.
clock_correction.evidence: Pinned Tokio 1.52.3 runtime/time/source.rs rounds deadlines up to a millisecond; time/sleep.rs documents millisecond granularity.
clock_correction.change: Test allows 3001ms. Production Redis response timeout remains three seconds; outer baseline/recovery tests still assert exact 120/300-second budgets.

limits: No reproduction of nested Docker or Consul latency.
No Sentinel election or real service restart in this target. Existing discovery/Sentinel targets are separate evidence.
No proof of stale cache admission, mirror coverage restoration, executor fallback or sustained client load from these observer tests.
